news.headline:
Bajaj Finance's AUM grew 26.5% YoY to approximately ₹584,750 crore as of 30 September 2026, adding ₹37,800 crore in Q2 FY27. Its customer franchise expanded to 128.9 million, gaining 4.5 million customers during the quarter.

New loans booked increased 11% YoY to 13.5 million in Q2 FY27 compared to 12.2 million in Q2 FY26. The company's total deposits book stood at approximately ₹69,750 crore as of 30 September 2026.

news.headline:
Vedanta Aluminium reported its highest-ever quarterly aluminium production of 649 KT and record H1 output of 1,281 KT. The company also recorded peak quarterly alumina production of 895 KT, driven by new smelter volumes, operational efficiencies, and expansion ramp-up.

BALCO commissioned the second zone of its 525 kA smelter potline, achieving 50% of its planned 435 KTPA expansion. Additionally, the firm secured Consent to Operate for the Sijimali Bauxite Block, while its shares closed 2.4% lower at ₹403.

Source: CNBC TV 18

Vedanta released Q2 FY27 production, reporting record H1 Zinc India mined metal of 539 KT (Q2 at 271 KT) and H1 saleable metal up 6% YoY at 524 KT. Q2 refined metal reached 264 KT, while Silver production stood at 173 metric tonnes.

Zinc International Q2 mined metal was 53 KT, with Gamsberg Phase 2 commissioned. Copper India sales stood at 52 KT, whereas Copper International sales dropped 74% YoY. The Ports division achieved its highest-ever H1 discharge volume of 4,185 KT.

Source: ScoutQuest

Hawa Engineers Limited reported standalone unaudited Q2 FY2027 results, with revenue from operations declining to 2,092.8 lakh compared to 3,152.8 lakh in Q2 FY2026.

Sequentially, the company's revenue from operations also dropped from 2,373.9 lakh recorded in the preceding quarter, Q1 FY2027.

Source: Equity Bulls

news.headline:
Tata Motors has toppled Mahindra to secure the No. 2 carmaker spot in H1FY27, after Mahindra previously beat Hyundai and Tata Motors to become the second-largest carmaker in H1FY26 and FY26.

Industry sales data shows Tata sold 376,840 cars in H1FY27, outpacing Mahindra's 358,142 units by nearly 20,000 units.

Source: Financial Express
